title: Open restriction square before the inverse pullback counits
statement: Let f:X→S, f′:X′→S′, g:S′→S, g′:X′→X form a cartesian square and U⊂X be open [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Supply the induced square for q:T=X′×X U→U and p:T→X′. Fix z∈T, i∈ℤ, and any complex P of O_X-modules. Put Q=restrict(U.ι)(P), Pg=tensorPullback(g′)(P), and let a,b be the additive comparisonIntoTensorPullback maps for P at pz and Q at z [lem-pc-affine-spectrum-ordinary-comparison-square]. Let η=openDerivedStalkIso(p,z,i), HU be additive derived-stalk cohomology at z [def-pc-open-derived-stalk-iso], and d=openRestrictedTensorDerivedIso(g′,U,P) [def-pc-open-restricted-tensor-complex-iso]. There exists a source isomorphism l such that a;η(DQ(Pg))=l.hom;b;HU(d.inv). No inverse pullback counit and no K-flatness are involved.

proof.text: Obtain eR,eA,eB,eD,q,t and their algebra and pure-tensor compatibility together with the geometric ordinary target homology equation. No base-derived source or comparison map occurs in this geometric statement.

Instantiate exists_baseDerivedTensor_ringIso_square with the actual two cohomologyModel objects, the ring isomorphisms, q, and t. This constructs the source isomorphism l and proves the localizedComparison square with the inverse exact restrictScalars homology isomorphism.

Postcompose that equation by the forward restrictScalars homology isomorphism, the restricted tensorStalkIso homology and exact-stalk homology inverse, and HU(d.inv). Cancel the restrictScalars factors, substitute the geometric target equation, and cancel HU(d.hom);HU(d.inv). Functor.map_comp and associativity identify the remaining factors with comparisonIntoTensorPullback and yield the required equation, reversed.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_open_restricted_ordinary_comparison_square
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (U : X.Opens)
    (sqU : IsPullback (pullback.snd g' U.ι) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f') (U.ι ≫ f) g)
    (z : (pullback g' U.ι : Scheme.{u})) (i : ℤ)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    let Q := ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let Pg := ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X'.presheaf.stalk (pullback.fst g' U.ι z)))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let FU := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((pullback g' U.ι).presheaf.stalk z))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let HU := comparisonStalkCohomology (pullback g' U.ι) z i ⋙ FU
    let a := F.map (comparisonIntoTensorPullback f f' g g' sq
      (pullback.fst g' U.ι z) P i)
    let b := FU.map (comparisonIntoTensorPullback (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f')
      g (pullback.snd g' U.ι) sqU z Q i)
    ∃ l : (Arrow.mk a).left ≅ (Arrow.mk b).left,
      a ≫ (openDerivedStalkIso (pullback.fst g' U.ι) z i).hom.app
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Pg) =
        l.hom ≫ b ≫ HU.map (openRestrictedTensorDerivedIso g' U P).inv
